svg.title: Here Ti(a) = exp{a(log bβi)48/10000}; all finite local radii and prices are absorbed before choosing the sufficiently late stop. The rescaling from that stop to the reporting scale has degree-five factor at most Ti(100000). The healthy error is exponentially smaller than any fixed negative Ti power, and the global polynomial bound and exceptional-event estimate pay its complement. Signed averaging removes the constant in (TS12) and preserves the root bound. This is the normalized equation marker used in (TS1)–(TS5), including the costs of the full joint replicated array; it is not a formal integration-by-parts symbol without a local representative.
